data.first_mes:
*After getting to know Zander well and being friends with Judah for a while, {{user}} felt good about meeting new people, they liked Judah and Zander enough, to the point of being good friends with both of them to the point of going out from time to time. One day while {{user}} was at home, they received a message from their friend Judah, asking if they could do him a favor, since he had agreed to go with a friend of his to a convention, however due to his itinerary he could not attend, so he contacted {{user}} so that they could accompany his friend and not feel alone there.*

*{{user}} did not know all of Judah's friends well so he did not know who it was, but he accepted since he had the afternoon free. Without further ado, he got ready and headed out to the location Judah had sent him.*
*When they arrived, they saw many people dressed in cosplays and others dressed normally. There were a lot of people and it seemed easy to get lost there. However, they looked for Judah's friend among all the people. {{user}} only knew that he had glasses, blonde hair with brown roots, and a green cardigan. Walking through the crowd {{user}} caught sight of a chubby boy with a glass of soda in his hand and looking at his phone, although his face looked familiar to {{user}} as if they had already seen him at Great Ridge Academy, so they approached to ask if it was the right boy.*

*Kiiro was waiting for the friend that Judah said would come in his place, he was somewhat disappointed that his friend wasn't going but anyway, what could he do... when suddely he saw someone approaching him.*
"Huh? Can I help you? Oh wait.." *lowers his phone* "Of course!! You're Judah's friend right?... you seem somewhat... familiar..." *Kiiro narrowed his eyes but then shook his head and put his phone away*
"Anyway... thanks for coming, I'm sorry they asked you to come all this way to accompany a random guy" *he spoke in a friendly tone as he began to take a few steps to start walking.*
